courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
related.titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
related.transfer: 可遷移「剪力牆系統與側力傳遞路徑」與「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Shear-wall systems and the lateral load path" and "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把設計圖上的韌性剪力牆真正做出來：邊界構材圍束、續接、鋼筋擁擠下的澆置與驗收；橋墩塑鉸韌性設計則以以容量設計、圍束箍筋與塑鉸轉角，讓橋墩在大地震中延展變形而不剪斷或倒塌為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building the ductile shear wall the drawings describe: boundary confinement, splices, placing concrete through congested steel, and acceptance; Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers centres on capacity design, confinement and plastic-hinge rotation that let piers deform in a major earthquake without shear failure or collapse, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「牆體側力分配」與「超強度彎矩 M_o」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋墩塑鉸韌性設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「擬靜態反覆載重試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Lateral force share between walls” and “Overstrength moment M_o”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Quasi-static cyclic column testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
history.text: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆自二十世紀中期成為中高層建築的主要抗側力系統，歷次大地震的經驗逐步把規範的重點從強度轉向牆端圍束與韌性。2010 年完工的哈里發塔以三翼高性能混凝土核心牆互相扶壁，形成抗扭勁度很高的扶壁式核心；2011 年 2 月 22 日基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌，紐西蘭皇家調查委員會在 2012 年的第六卷報告中檢討其結構系統與樓板拉桿補強。ACI 318-19 把邊界構材的判斷改為以 1.5 倍設計位移計算，反映對牆端應變需求的新認識。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Reinforced-concrete shear walls became the main lateral system of mid- and high-rise buildings from the mid-twentieth century, and experience from successive major earthquakes gradually shifted code emphasis from strength to wall-end confinement and ductility. Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, uses high-performance concrete core walls in three wings that buttress one another, forming a buttressed core with very high torsional stiffness; after the CTV Building in Christchurch collapsed on 22 February 2011, Volume 6 of the New Zealand Royal Commission's 2012 report reviewed its structural system and drag-bar retrofit. ACI 318-19 changed the boundary-element check to use 1.5 times the design displacement, reflecting new understanding of wall-end strain demands. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
